item.title: [看到华为三星折叠机受关注后，库克推动苹果加速研发折叠屏 iPhone] After Seeing Huawei and Samsung Foldables Gain Attention, Cook Pushes Apple to Accelerate Foldable iPhone R&D
item.guid: 看到华为三星折叠机受关注后，库克推动苹果加速研发折叠屏-iPhone
item.description:
According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, Apple's journey to develop a foldable iPhone has spanned nearly a decade. The device is expected to cost over $2,000, marking Apple's biggest design change in nearly 20 years.

The report reveals that Apple's focus on foldable devices dates back to around 2020. At that time, Apple CEO Tim Cook showed unusually positive enthusiasm for the emerging category of foldable phones after concluding an Asia trip.

During his visits to Asian regions, including China, Tim Cook observed an increasing number of consumers using foldable devices from manufacturers like Samsung Electronics and Huawei. This observation convinced him that Apple must launch its own foldable product, and he immediately pushed the company to accelerate its R&D efforts in this emerging market.

item.title: [OpenAI 发布 Navier–Stokes 千禧年难题候选解，等待数学界检验] OpenAI Releases Candidate Solution for Navier–Stokes Millennium Problem, Awaiting Mathematical Community Review
item.guid: OpenAI-发布-Navier–Stokes-千禧年难题候选解，等待数学界检验
item.description:
On September 8, OpenAI announced a candidate solution to the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness problem, along with a mathematical paper and a Lean formal proof. The company states that this proof provides a construction for the formation of singularities in smooth three-dimensional incompressible fluids within a finite time, corresponding to cases C and D in the Clay Mathematics Institute's problem statement.

OpenAI claims the proof was completed by an internal model with capabilities superior to GPT-6 Astra, a system that at one point coordinated approximately 10,000 concurrent agents. It took about 88 hours from initiation to obtaining the candidate solution, followed by 17 hours for GPT-6 Astra to complete the Lean formalization and verification; the Navier–Stokes project generated approximately 2.7 million agent messages and 130 billion output tokens.

This work also brought to light a concurrent controversy regarding Euler equation research. Tristan Buckmaster, a mathematics professor at New York University, questioned whether OpenAI had used his project data with Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge in Codex. OpenAI stated that the solving process did not access specific user data but could not completely rule out the possibility that de-identified usage data had contributed to model improvement; the problems addressed by the proofs publicly released by both parties are also not identical.

This candidate solution has not yet undergone independent verification by the global mathematical community. According to Clay Mathematics Institute rules, a solution must first be published in a qualified publication, undergo at least two years of rigorous review, and gain widespread acceptance before entering the award consideration process. OpenAI stated it has no intention of applying for an award for this result.

🔗 Related reading: Just now, OpenAI announced it has solved a Millennium Problem; Chen Lijie, a legend from Tsinghua's Yao Class: An incredible era

item.title: [DeepSeek Flash 系列 9 月 10 日起降价，V4.1 Flash 同步开启内测] DeepSeek Flash Series Price Reduction Starting September 10, V4.1 Flash Internal Testing Simultaneously Begins
item.guid: DeepSeek-Flash-系列-9-月-10-日起降价，V4.1-Flash-同步开启内测
item.description:
DeepSeek will significantly adjust the pricing of its Flash series models starting at 12:00 on September 10. Off-peak input prices will drop from 1.5 yuan per million tokens to 1 yuan, off-peak output prices from 4.5 yuan to 4 yuan, and off-peak cache prices from 0.05 yuan to 0.02 yuan; peak-time prices will be double the off-peak prices.

Concurrently, an intermediate version of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has opened for internal testing. API users participating in the internal test do not need to change the base_url; they can call the model by switching the model name to "deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910". Current billing is the same as DeepSeek V4 Flash, with a maximum of 20 concurrent requests per account.

The expiration date in this model ID is September 10, indicating a short-term internal test version that has not yet replaced the official V4 Flash model in the API documentation. The new version adopts a different model architecture, natively supports multimodal capabilities, and this round of testing focuses on capabilities, generation speed, and inference costs.

🔗 Related reading: Just now, DeepSeek's new model suddenly launched, Flash's model, Pro's ambition

item.title: [两部门要求车企定期报告供应商账期，重点企业每年接受评估] Two Departments Require Automakers to Periodically Report Supplier Payment Terms, Key Enterprises to Undergo Annual Assessment
item.guid: 两部门要求车企定期报告供应商账期，重点企业每年接受评估
item.description:
The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the State Administration for Market Regulation issued a notice on September 7, further standardizing payments made by automotive companies to suppliers for goods, engineering, and services. Automakers are required to establish a supplier payment management system and submit semi-annual and annual implementation reports by the end of July and the end of January of the following year, respectively.

The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology will entrust a third-party agency to conduct an annual survey and assessment, covering all key automakers on the list. The assessment will involve reviewing company documents and data, verifying on-site conditions, and interviewing employees, focusing on information such as payment terms, payment methods and their proportions, and the scale of accounts payable. The results will be publicly released.

For automakers with large accounts payable, those who intentionally extend payment terms, or those who receive numerous complaints from small and medium-sized enterprises, the competent authorities will hold talks and urge rectification; if violations are involved, they will be dealt with according to law. Previously, the industry launched a '60-day payment term commitment' in 2025. This notice incorporates corporate reporting, third-party assessment, complaint verification, and law enforcement coordination into the normalized management process.

item.title: [小米中折叠「卖爆了」，首销较上代大折叠增长 310%] Xiaomi's Mid-Foldable 'Sold Out,' First Sales Up 310% Compared to Previous Generation Large Foldable
item.guid: 小米中折叠「卖爆了」，首销较上代大折叠增长-310%
item.description: Xu Fei, Vice President and CMO of Xiaomi Group, stated on September 8 that the first sales of the Xiaomi 18 Fold increased by 310% compared to the previous generation's large foldable. This mid-foldable phone was launched the previous evening with a starting price of 10,999 yuan, making it Xiaomi's highest-positioned phone product currently.

item.title: [曝微信 PC 版接入 AI 助手「小微」，可操作聊天与小程序] WeChat PC Version Reportedly Integrates AI Assistant 'Xiaowei,' Capable of Operating Chats and Mini Programs
item.guid: 曝微信-PC-版接入-AI-助手「小微」，可操作聊天与小程序
item.description:
WeChat has begun testing its AI assistant 'Xiaowei' on the PC version. It can view Moments, send messages, initiate voice and video calls, and answer questions about file content in chats; video files and scheduled messages are not yet supported.

'Xiaowei' can also invoke mini programs to complete services like ordering food, and will prompt users for confirmation when payments are involved. The 'Yuanbao Summary' entry in WeChat's built-in browser has also been replaced with 'Ask AI,' allowing users to continue asking questions about the current webpage.

Developer-facing capabilities include developing and debugging mini programs on PC, and generating trial versions. Personalized recommendations are off by default and can be enabled by users in settings; currently, there is no option to disable the 'Xiaowei' entry.

item.title: [蔚来与云南交投新一批高速换电站投运，覆盖 5 条高速双向服务区] NIO and Yunnan Communications Investment Group Launch New Batch of Highway Battery Swap Stations, Covering 5 Expressways with Bi-directional Service Areas
item.guid: 蔚来与云南交投新一批高速换电站投运，覆盖-5-条高速双向服务区
item.description:
NIO Energy and Yunnan Communications Investment Group announced on September 8 that their new batch of jointly built highway battery swap stations has been fully put into operation. The stations are located at Disuoping on G5621 Kunchuda Expressway, Huize on G85 Yinkun Expressway, Shizong on G78 Shankun Expressway, Yuanmou on G5 Jingkun Expressway, and Tongguan Service Area on G8511 Kunmo Expressway, with all 5 service areas completing bi-directional deployment.

This marks a new round of operations following the first batch of cooperation between the two parties in 2024. The new stations connect major arteries in central, eastern, western, and southern Yunnan, filling gaps in high-speed battery swap nodes for inter-regional, long-distance travel within the province. The two parties will also further promote highway "solar-storage-charging-swapping" integrated energy stations and zero-carbon service areas.

As of September 8, NIO stated that it has built 9,328 charging and battery swap stations, including 4,075 battery swap stations and 5,253 charging stations, equipped with 30,284 charging piles; it has completed over 120 million battery swap services, with a total of over 200 million charging and battery swap services.

item.title: [DeepSeek 新开约 150 个工程岗位，聚焦后端与 Agent 弹性计算] DeepSeek Opens Approximately 150 New Engineering Positions, Focusing on Backend and Agent Elastic Computing
item.guid: DeepSeek-新开约-150-个工程岗位，聚焦后端与-Agent-弹性计算
item.description:
Cui Tianyi, head of the DeepSeek Harness team, announced on September 7 that the company is recruiting approximately 150 people. These positions are primarily for engineers with 2 to 10 years of experience, but fresh graduates and entry-level professionals are also welcome; the main work location is Beijing, with some positions offering Hangzhou as an option.

Recruitment focuses on two categories: server-side development and Agent elastic computing R&D. The former covers large model research platforms, Agent framework components, R&D efficiency infrastructure, DeepSeek API, online services, and data engineering; the latter includes platform development and maintenance, and underlying system optimization. There are no separate AI research positions in this round.

Cui Tianyi explained that data, machines and containers, training and evaluation tasks, Agent environments, and user requests are all growing, requiring the existing backend systems to be upgraded, maintained, or even rewritten. In June, DeepSeek had announced plans to at least double the size of its various departments; this round of recruitment has a more focused scope of positions.

item.title: [高通与亚马逊达成多代定制芯片合作，覆盖 AI 推理与 1.6T 光互联] Qualcomm and Amazon Announce Multi-Generational Custom Chip Collaboration, Covering AI Inference and 1.6T Optical Interconnect
item.guid: 高通与亚马逊达成多代定制芯片合作，覆盖-AI-推理与-1.6T-光互联
item.description:
Qualcomm announced on September 8 that it has reached a multi-generational product collaboration with Amazon. The two parties will develop custom chips for AWS's large-scale AI data centers and jointly advance AI inference infrastructure. The collaboration will also cover optical interconnects up to 1.6T and subsequent solutions.

Qualcomm will provide SerDes, optical DSPs, low-power computing, and system integration capabilities to enhance high-bandwidth interconnects within data centers. Amazon will provide cloud-based AI infrastructure, and the two parties aim to create a scalable solution across computing, storage, network bandwidth, and energy efficiency.

Qualcomm also plans to expand its use of AWS AI infrastructure and Amazon Bedrock for electronic design automation workloads to shorten chip design cycles.

item.title: [MagicOS 11 定档 9 月 15 日发布，主打系统级 Agent] MagicOS 11 Scheduled for September 15 Release, Featuring System-Level Agent
item.guid: MagicOS-11-定档-9-月-15-日发布，主打系统级-Agent
item.description:
Honor has announced the schedule for its 2026 Global Developer Conference. MagicOS 11 will be released on September 15 from 19:00 to 20:00 in Shenzhen. The official positioning for the new system is the commercial implementation of a system-level Agent, with sub-forums on AI, gaming, and smart home to further introduce development capabilities.

Announced system changes include a new liquid glass visual effect, lossless compression and redundant file cleanup, multi-protocol fast charging adaptation, and weak network optimization with AI-selected networks. Honor states that the overall fluency of all series models will increase by more than 20%, and a 4K Live "shoot-while-recording" feature will be added.

Honor has not yet listed compatible models or specific upgrade batches. The developer conference will last one day, with the system release scheduled for the evening main forum.

item.title: [iQOO 16 与 iQOO Pad Ultra 定档 9 月底发布] iQOO 16 and iQOO Pad Ultra Scheduled for Late September Release
item.description:
iQOO has announced that the iQOO 16 phone and iQOO Pad Ultra tablet will be released together at the end of September. Official teaser videos show the names and back designs of both products; the phone continues to use a square camera module, while the tablet features a centered matrix lens area.

Existing leaks suggest that the iQOO 16 will feature a 6.8-inch flat screen, a fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Ultimate Edition processor, and a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto lens, with a battery capacity possibly exceeding 7000mAh; the iQOO Pad Ultra may be equipped with a Dimensity 9600, a 14-inch screen, and a 16000mAh battery. These specifications have not yet been officially confirmed.

Certification information indicates that the iQOO 16 is expected to support 66W wired charging. iQOO will announce the full configurations and sales arrangements at the launch event at the end of the month.

item.title: [智象未来 vivago R1 全球上线，主打 5 分钟长视频生成] HiDream.ai vivago R1 Launches Globally, Specializing in 5-Minute Long Video Generation
item.guid: 智象未来-vivago-R1-全球上线，主打-5-分钟长视频生成
item.description:
HiDream.ai yesterday announced the global launch of its content creation AI intelligent agent vivago R1, with its domestic version "Gouda" simultaneously upgraded.

Official data shows that vivago.ai's global user base has exceeded 70 million. Unlike the industry's mainstream 15 to 30-second short clip generation, vivago R1 focuses on long video creation, supporting stable output of 5-minute high-quality videos in one go, and possessing unlimited multi-round extension capabilities.

The product adopts a "Chat-First" model, where users do not need to adjust complex nodes and parameters, but can drive video generation and modification through natural language dialogue.

At the underlying architecture level, the product relies on its self-developed HD-AgentOS for task decomposition and multi-Agent collaboration. The official statement claims that the success rate of effective and usable content has increased to 85%, effectively alleviating the problem of inconsistent characters and scenes across different shots. vivago R1 is currently open for global users to experience.

🔗 Related reading: Hands-on with the globally launched vivago R1, I used it to create a cyberpunk Journey to the West short film
